== English Tatooine comparison ==
The 29 January 2002 Decipher Glossary Supplement explains that the Used function refers to I Feel The Conflict. A 2009 capture of the Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1 and the 2013 errata slip show the complete replacement. The Lost function agrees across the printed and PC faces.
